rows.text: UNCONTROLLED COPY WHEN PRINTED Version 1 UNCONTROLLED COPY WHEN PRINTED Page 1 of 1 CIVILIAN SUPERNUMERARY CREW MEDICAL SELF DECLARATION By signing this form, I am declaring that I meet the medical standards for the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency Group 1 Licence and I am fit to operate as Supernumerary Crew. Specifically, I am not suffering from, nor have previously suffered from: - Diabetes or insulin reliant; - Syncope (fainting); - Heart conditions (including atrial fibrillation and pacemakers); - Sleep apnoea; - Epilepsy; - Stroke; - Glaucoma. I also declare that I am not suffering from, nor have previously suffered from: - Being prescribed medication for any psychiatric illness; - Bipolar disorder, psychosis or a diagnosis of personality disorder; - Drug abuse or alcohol misuse or addiction (or conviction for drink/drug driving); - Being prescribed medication or treatment for angina or heart failure; - Cardiac surgical procedures including cardiac device implantation; - Recurrent fainting or collapse (syncope); - Unexplained loss of consciousness; - Insulin treatment; - Chronic lung disease with shortness of breath on exertion; - Any neurological condition requiring medication; - Seizures or epilepsy; - Significant functional physical disability likely to impair safe operation on an Air System. If you are or have previously suffered from any of the above conditions, you must visit a Military Aviation Medical Examiner (MAME) and should not operate as Supernumerary Crew until you have been issued a medical certificate to do so by a MAME.
This form is valid for 90 days from the date signed.
